message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s). Facts: theft of public lighting cable (road lamp cable) from public infrastructure, multiple times, sold to scrap. This is theft of public property, endangering public safety. Under Chinese criminal law, theft of public property (公私财物) is theft (盗窃罪). Also, damaging public safety could be "破坏交通设施罪"? Actually stealing road lamp cables may be considered "盗窃公用电线电缆罪"? There's a specific provision: Article 264 of Criminal Law: theft of public property (including public electric cables) is theft. Also, there is "破坏交通设施罪" (Article 107) for damaging road facilities, but theft of cables may be considered "破坏交通设施罪" if causing danger. However typical case: theft of public electric cables is prosecuted under theft (盗窃罪) with aggravating factor of endangering public safety. So likely charge: 盗窃罪.

The correction rules: When listing crime name(s) between [罪名] and <eoa>, output only statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "盗窃". Not "盗窃罪". Also if multiple crimes, separate with semicolon.

Thus final answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>
